card.name: Just before a word starting with col
card.fires_on: Pieces of text where the next piece is likely to begin with "col", such as "Collision", "Colitis", "colli" or "cortic". It fires on the piece just before it, including hyphens, section numbers and word stems.

modes.label: Before collision or colitis
modes.description: The piece right before a word that continues as col-, such as Collision or Colitis.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Partway through words like anticholinergic, antecollis or ulcerative where col- is nearby or expected.

modes.label: Numbers in references
modes.description: A digit inside a section reference or a dose range, followed by a dot or another digit.
modes.example: Lactated Ringer’s Injection is for intravenous use. ( <<2>>.3 )

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a following piece that begins with "col" and suppresses unrelated Chinese-script and name pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the piece just before a word starting with "col", such as colitis or collision.
